name: comp-279
title: Dismissible Warning Toast
description: Toast-style warning message with a close button. Typically used in toast stacks for temporary notifications that auto-dismiss or can be manually closed.
use_when: Showing temporary warning notifications in a toast queue, especially at top or bottom of page.
avoid_when: Persistent warnings needing sustained attention. When state changes should be modal.
a11y: Close button lacks ARIA label. No toast role or aria-live. Parent toast container should manage announcements and roles.
